ats.title: Job board (for a single company)
ats.description: Leave the Companies (multiple) field below empty to use this single-company shortcut instead.

slug.title: Company slug (for a single company)
slug.description: The company's identifier in its job board's own URL, e.g. https://boards.greenhouse.io/stripe -> "stripe"; https://jobs.lever.co/palantir -> "palantir". Only used together with the Job board field above.

boards.title: Company job boards (multiple)
boards.description: For checking several companies' boards in one run instead of one at a time. List of { "ats": "greenhouse"|"lever", "slug": "company-board-slug" }. Ignored if Company slug above is filled in.

keywordFilter.title: Title keyword filter
keywordFilter.description: Only keep jobs whose title contains one of these (case-insensitive). Leave empty to keep all jobs.

includeDescription.title: Include full job description
includeDescription.description: Fetch the full job description text (larger records). Off by default.
